newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end sharply lower after BOJ "tankan".
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end sharply lower after BOJ "tankan".

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended near their lowest level for the day on Wednesday, as concerns over the Japanese economy grew after the Japanese central bank's quarterly "tankan" survey of corporations for August showed unexpectedly weaker business sentiment.
Brokers said, however, that a further fall in share prices would be limited as lingering fears of a hike in Japanese interest rates have disappeared.

The cash stock market's key Nikkei 225 average ended down 200.46 points or 0.96 percent at 20,709.81. In the futures market, the benchmark September futures contract lost 230 points to finish at 20,720.
